entities.name: Abdul Karim Jili
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: ʿAbd al-Karīm al-Jīlī, or Abdul Karim Jili was a Muslim Sufi saint and mystic who was born in 1365, in what is modern day Iraq, possibly in the neighborhood of Jil in Baghdad. He is known in Muslim mysticism as the author of Universal Man.
